records.text: On the night before Charlie Kirk was killed, Josh Hammer and several others joined a Zoom call Kirk organized to prepare messaging about Jewish-Christian relations and Israel on college campuses.
records.speaker: Josh Hammer

appearances.snippet: if you look at the timestamps, two hours after that, I and a few others were in a small Zoom chat, a small Zoom. Zoom call with Charlie Kirk the night before he was killed, that Charlie organized. Charlie organized this Zoom call for the express purpose of trying to make sure that he had all the best answers, the best messaging advice for how to speak about Jewish-Christian relations and the Israel question on college campuses.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Multiple direct participant accounts and contemporaneous reporting confirm that Kirk organized a Zoom call the night before his death to prepare answers and messaging about Israel and Jewish-Christian relations for campus appearances. Josh Hammer and other named participants were on the call.

records.text: Charlie Kirk had what looked like an emergency Zoom call with Pesach Wolicki at 4 a.m. Israel time, two hours after Wolicki was in the group chat.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He then has what looks like an emergency Zoom call with Rabbi Wolicki (Rabbi Pesach Wolicki). Now, I want you to bear in mind, this is 4 a.m. in Israel. Rabbi Wolicki (Rabbi Pesach Wolicki) lives in Israel. It's 4 a.m. and he's going to jump on this call with Charlie (Charlie Kirk). And he was just on this chat. He was on the chat two hours earlier before this call when Charlie (Charlie Kirk) said that he would no longer be bullied.

verification.notes: Wolicki's own public account and contemporaneous reporting confirm an hour-long Zoom call with Kirk the night before the shooting; reporting also confirms Wolicki was Israel-based and belonged to Kirk's Israel-focused group chat. The characterization as an emergency and the precise 4 a.m./two-hours-later sequence depend on Owens's interpretation of leaked timestamps and were not independently confirmed.

records.text: Just days after Charlie Kirk's death, Erika Kirk was laying out ambitious plans for Turning Point USA over Zoom and appeared already deeply involved in the business.
records.speaker: Elizabeth Lane

appearances.snippet: Just days after her husband's death, ... she was already laying out ambitious plans for the company over Zoom. ... It's obvious she was always deeply involved in the business and knew exactly where to pick up when her turn came.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed (Elizabeth Lane quoted post). Current reporting confirms Erika Kirk held an employee Zoom call within days of Charlie Kirk's death and discussed making TPUSA ten times larger. That supports the reported ambitious plans; 'appeared deeply involved' remains an evaluative inference, so confidence is medium.
